title: MSR 2027 SkillGuard RQ2 Defect Taxonomy
method_note: R1-R7 names/31 IDs reproduced from Zhang et al. Figure 1; operational rules are project implementations. P1-P5 and S1-S4 are explicitly our additions. Do not claim full equivalence with published detectors.

sources.name: Zhang et al., What Keeps Agent Skills from Being Reusable?
Hong et al., From Anatomy to Smells

original_taxonomy.name: Missing description
original_taxonomy.origin: Zhang et al. (reproduced ID, project-operationalized criterion)
original_taxonomy.trigger: Parsed YAML frontmatter has no description key or its trimmed value is empty.
original_taxonomy.exclusion: Treat YAML parse failures separately under S02; do not treat an empty description as a missing trigger phrase.
original_taxonomy.verification: Parse YAML and assert a nonempty string.
original_taxonomy.repair: Add a description stating function and invocation context.

original_taxonomy.name: Description too short
original_taxonomy.origin: Zhang et al. (reproduced ID, project-operationalized criterion)
original_taxonomy.trigger: Description length after trim is <30 Unicode characters.
original_taxonomy.exclusion: This 30-character threshold comes from the study, not the official minimum of one character.
original_taxonomy.verification: Count Unicode code points in the parsed description.
original_taxonomy.repair: Add the action and suitable trigger wording.

original_taxonomy.name: Missing trigger guidance
original_taxonomy.origin: Zhang et al. (reproduced ID, project-operationalized criterion)
original_taxonomy.trigger: Description conveys the action but never states a usage condition, triggering situation, or task type.
original_taxonomy.exclusion: Do not require literal words "Use when"; equivalent language counts.
original_taxonomy.verification: Researcher highlights actionable trigger span; if none, confirm candidate.
original_taxonomy.repair: Add a specific when-to-use condition.

original_taxonomy.name: Non-functional description
original_taxonomy.origin: Zhang et al. (reproduced ID, project-operationalized criterion)
original_taxonomy.trigger: Description fails to identify a concrete capability or differentiating outcome (e.g., "helps with things").
original_taxonomy.exclusion: Short yet precise descriptions are not automatically nonfunctional.
original_taxonomy.verification: Researcher states what task could be routed from description alone.
original_taxonomy.repair: Name the action, target artifact, and distinguishing capability.

original_taxonomy.name: Overlong routing description
original_taxonomy.origin: Zhang et al. (reproduced ID, project-operationalized criterion)
original_taxonomy.trigger: Description length after trim >300 characters (paper Figure 1 baseline).
original_taxonomy.exclusion: 301–1024 characters violates the paper heuristic but not the official 1024-character maximum; >1024 is S04.
original_taxonomy.verification: Count exact characters and record both warning and spec-validity result.
original_taxonomy.repair: Front-load the trigger; move detail to the body.

original_taxonomy.name: Routing guidance only in body
original_taxonomy.origin: Zhang et al. (reproduced ID, project-operationalized criterion)
original_taxonomy.trigger: Body contains explicit when-to-use/trigger guidance missing from the description.
original_taxonomy.exclusion: A trigger included in both locations is fine.
original_taxonomy.verification: Compare frontmatter description to relevant body sentence(s).
original_taxonomy.repair: Move or summarize trigger guidance into description.

original_taxonomy.name: Oversized body
original_taxonomy.origin: Zhang et al. (reproduced ID, project-operationalized criterion)
original_taxonomy.trigger: SKILL.md Markdown body has >500 physical lines, excluding frontmatter.
original_taxonomy.exclusion: The 500-line target is guidance, not an invalid SKILL.md format.
original_taxonomy.verification: Count splitlines() of body with pinned parser settings.
original_taxonomy.repair: Move optional details into referenced files.

original_taxonomy.name: Non-actionable body
original_taxonomy.origin: Zhang et al. (reproduced ID, project-operationalized criterion)
original_taxonomy.trigger: Body does not give identifiable instructions, constraints, or executable decisions for its stated task.
original_taxonomy.exclusion: An information-reference skill can be useful without numbered steps.
original_taxonomy.verification: Researcher identifies at least one concrete agent action or decision; assess absence.
original_taxonomy.repair: Add actionable procedure and expected output.

original_taxonomy.name: Explains obvious
original_taxonomy.origin: Zhang et al. (reproduced ID, project-operationalized criterion)
original_taxonomy.trigger: Body spends substantive space defining generic concepts not needed to perform the advertised task.
original_taxonomy.exclusion: Domain-specific prerequisites and safety explanations are not redundant.
original_taxonomy.verification: Mark unnecessary span and explain why task success does not require it.
original_taxonomy.repair: Remove or move elementary exposition.

original_taxonomy.name: Name repeated as H1
original_taxonomy.origin: Zhang et al. (reproduced ID, project-operationalized criterion)
original_taxonomy.trigger: First H1 of body is textually identical to frontmatter name after lowercasing, replacing hyphens/underscores with spaces and trimming punctuation.
original_taxonomy.exclusion: A descriptive H1 that adds additional words does not trigger.
original_taxonomy.verification: Normalize title and name with documented function; compare.
original_taxonomy.repair: Use a descriptive title or remove duplicated heading.

original_taxonomy.name: Description duplicated in body
original_taxonomy.origin: Zhang et al. (reproduced ID, project-operationalized criterion)
original_taxonomy.trigger: First body paragraph repeats the full description verbatim after collapsing whitespace and case.
original_taxonomy.exclusion: Partial elaboration or paraphrase is not a verbatim duplicate.
original_taxonomy.verification: Compare exact normalized strings; store matching span.
original_taxonomy.repair: Remove redundant introductory copy.

original_taxonomy.name: Excessive inline code
original_taxonomy.origin: Zhang et al. (reproduced ID, project-operationalized criterion)
original_taxonomy.trigger: More than 60% of nonblank body lines lie inside fenced code blocks.
original_taxonomy.exclusion: Ratio is our reproducible implementation of the paper threshold, not a claim about its original exact parser.
original_taxonomy.verification: Use a Markdown fence parser, report numerator/denominator.
original_taxonomy.repair: Move implementation to scripts and reference from SKILL.md.

original_taxonomy.name: Too many code examples
original_taxonomy.origin: Zhang et al. (reproduced ID, project-operationalized criterion)
original_taxonomy.trigger: More than eight fenced code blocks occur in the SKILL.md body.
original_taxonomy.exclusion: Code blocks are a proxy for examples; a block containing essential output syntax may not be an example.
original_taxonomy.verification: Parse Markdown fences and count blocks.
original_taxonomy.repair: Consolidate or move examples to references.

original_taxonomy.name: Monolithic skill without resources
original_taxonomy.origin: Zhang et al. (reproduced ID, project-operationalized criterion)
original_taxonomy.trigger: Body >300 lines AND the package has no scripts/ or references/ files that are actually referenced.
original_taxonomy.exclusion: 300 is an explicit project pilot threshold; tune in sensitivity analysis and do not attribute it to the paper.
original_taxonomy.verification: Count body lines, inventory files, parse explicit links.
original_taxonomy.repair: Externalize optional details and scripts while preserving entry point.

original_taxonomy.name: Installation instructions in body
original_taxonomy.origin: Zhang et al. (reproduced ID, project-operationalized criterion)
original_taxonomy.trigger: SKILL.md contains explicit package/plugin installation steps unrelated to executing the skill.
original_taxonomy.exclusion: Required runtime setup may be legitimate; do not classify all pip/npm commands as a defect.
original_taxonomy.verification: Review command and whether it is necessary and documented.
original_taxonomy.repair: Move optional installation guide to a setup reference.

original_taxonomy.name: Changelog in active instructions
original_taxonomy.origin: Zhang et al. (reproduced ID, project-operationalized criterion)
original_taxonomy.trigger: Body includes a CHANGELOG/Version History section with historical entries.
original_taxonomy.exclusion: A version constraint for an API is not a changelog.
original_taxonomy.verification: Locate heading and dated/versioned entries.
original_taxonomy.repair: Move history to CHANGELOG.md.

original_taxonomy.name: License boilerplate in body
original_taxonomy.origin: Zhang et al. (reproduced ID, project-operationalized criterion)
original_taxonomy.trigger: Body reproduces a full copyright/license clause instead of referring to LICENSE.
original_taxonomy.exclusion: A brief legally necessary usage restriction is not automatically problematic.
original_taxonomy.verification: Identify license passage and its location.
original_taxonomy.repair: Move full license into a dedicated file and reference it.

original_taxonomy.name: Unfinished markers
original_taxonomy.origin: Zhang et al. (reproduced ID, project-operationalized criterion)
original_taxonomy.trigger: Operational prose contains TODO, FIXME, TBD, or a placeholder requiring completion.
original_taxonomy.exclusion: Do not count markers in explicitly labeled examples or code demonstrating how to find TODOs.
original_taxonomy.verification: Record marker and its syntactic context.
original_taxonomy.repair: Complete or remove placeholder.

original_taxonomy.name: Hardcoded credentials
original_taxonomy.origin: Zhang et al. (reproduced ID, project-operationalized criterion)
original_taxonomy.trigger: Static content contains a plausible live API key, token, password, or private key intended for reuse.
original_taxonomy.exclusion: Synthetic examples, placeholders, and public test vectors are not confirmed exposures. Never reproduce credential values in reports.
original_taxonomy.verification: Run detector on redacted output; manual contextual review; do not validate keys against providers.
original_taxonomy.repair: Remove/rotate credentials and load from secure runtime configuration.

original_taxonomy.name: Safety bypass instruction
original_taxonomy.origin: Zhang et al. (reproduced ID, project-operationalized criterion)
original_taxonomy.trigger: Active instructions/scripts disable integrity or safety controls (e.g., --no-verify, disabled certificate verification).
original_taxonomy.exclusion: A quotation in security-training documentation is not an active bypass.
original_taxonomy.verification: Trace whether bypass executes as part of workflow.
original_taxonomy.repair: Use safe defaults; document exceptional cases with justification.

original_taxonomy.name: Instruction hierarchy / injection pattern
original_taxonomy.origin: Zhang et al. (reproduced ID, project-operationalized criterion)
original_taxonomy.trigger: Skill instructs the agent to ignore higher-priority instructions, or asks it to follow untrusted data as authoritative commands.
original_taxonomy.exclusion: Legitimate defensive examples and quotations are not automatically attacks.
original_taxonomy.verification: Identify attacker-controlled surface, instruction redirection, and trust boundary.
original_taxonomy.repair: Separate data from commands; respect instruction hierarchy.

original_taxonomy.name: Unguarded destructive actions
original_taxonomy.origin: Zhang et al. (reproduced ID, project-operationalized criterion)
original_taxonomy.trigger: Active steps can erase/overwrite data, change cron/jobs, or terminate unrelated processes without a stated scope check, preview, or user approval where material.
original_taxonomy.exclusion: Expected, narrow, user-authorized operations with adequate scope guards are not automatically defects.
original_taxonomy.verification: Identify exact side effect and safeguards in entire package.
original_taxonomy.repair: Add confirmation, dry run, path/target constraints, and rollback where feasible.

original_taxonomy.name: Error suppression
original_taxonomy.origin: Zhang et al. (reproduced ID, project-operationalized criterion)
original_taxonomy.trigger: Exceptions/nonzero exits that materially affect success are silently discarded and workflow reports success.
original_taxonomy.exclusion: Best-effort cleanup with documented tolerable failure can be appropriate.
original_taxonomy.verification: Trace error to caller and final user-visible status.
original_taxonomy.repair: Handle and surface failure or narrow exception scope.

original_taxonomy.name: User-specific path leakage
original_taxonomy.origin: Zhang et al. (reproduced ID, project-operationalized criterion)
original_taxonomy.trigger: Literal absolute path exposes an individual home directory/account/machine path not required by functionality.
original_taxonomy.exclusion: Generic example paths and env-based path expansion are not user leakage.
original_taxonomy.verification: Record redacted pattern, classify as leak vs portable placeholder.
original_taxonomy.repair: Use relative paths, $HOME, Path.home(), or parametrization.

original_taxonomy.name: Hardcoded model name
original_taxonomy.origin: Zhang et al. (reproduced ID, project-operationalized criterion)
original_taxonomy.trigger: Task is broadly advertised but requires a specific named LLM model with no supported alternative.
original_taxonomy.exclusion: A skill explicitly intended for that model is not necessarily defective.
original_taxonomy.verification: Compare description, compatibility, and actual invocation.
original_taxonomy.repair: Parameterize model or specify dependency explicitly.

original_taxonomy.name: Platform-specific hardcoded paths
original_taxonomy.origin: Zhang et al. (reproduced ID, project-operationalized criterion)
original_taxonomy.trigger: Hardcoded Windows drive or Unix absolute path is required for operation but not documented or parameterized.
original_taxonomy.exclusion: Generic /tmp and user-supplied paths may be intentional; Windows backslash notation is not itself a defect.
original_taxonomy.verification: Trace path through scripts and reference docs; check compatibility.
original_taxonomy.repair: Use path libraries and configurable roots.

original_taxonomy.name: Platform-specific tool calls
original_taxonomy.origin: Zhang et al. (reproduced ID, project-operationalized criterion)
original_taxonomy.trigger: Instructions require an agent-host-specific tool/API without stating platform compatibility or fallback.
original_taxonomy.exclusion: Platform-scoped skill with explicit compatibility is acceptable.
original_taxonomy.verification: Check tool references against declared host and adapter availability.
original_taxonomy.repair: State platform requirement or provide fallback.

original_taxonomy.name: OS-specific commands
original_taxonomy.origin: Zhang et al. (reproduced ID, project-operationalized criterion)
original_taxonomy.trigger: Essential command is OS-specific (e.g., pbcopy, apt, crontab) but no OS requirement or alternative is documented.
original_taxonomy.exclusion: Explicitly platform-scoped skills are not automatically defective.
original_taxonomy.verification: Cross-check script commands and compatibility metadata.
original_taxonomy.repair: Document OS dependency or offer alternative.

original_taxonomy.name: Persona redefinition
original_taxonomy.origin: Zhang et al. (reproduced ID, project-operationalized criterion)
original_taxonomy.trigger: Skill orders agent to assume a conflicting primary identity or overarching role rather than a bounded task role.
original_taxonomy.exclusion: Task personas ("act as a code reviewer") can be benign.
original_taxonomy.verification: Compare claimed role to skill scope and host instruction hierarchy.
original_taxonomy.repair: Limit role wording to task-specific expertise.

original_taxonomy.name: Overrides prior instructions
original_taxonomy.origin: Zhang et al. (reproduced ID, project-operationalized criterion)
original_taxonomy.trigger: Active directive claims precedence over system/developer/user rules or instructs to ignore earlier constraints.
original_taxonomy.exclusion: Quoting malicious prompts in defensive material is not an active override.
original_taxonomy.verification: Locate imperative claim and determine whether it is active instruction.
original_taxonomy.repair: Remove override; state bounded workflow requirements.

original_taxonomy.name: Scope mismatch
original_taxonomy.origin: Zhang et al. (reproduced ID, project-operationalized criterion)
original_taxonomy.trigger: Body/script performs an unrelated task or requests privileges/data not implied by description.
original_taxonomy.exclusion: Necessary internal subtasks are not automatically out of scope.
original_taxonomy.verification: Compare description, process behavior, and data flows; identify unrelated effect.
original_taxonomy.repair: Revise description/permissions or remove unrelated behavior.

project_package_extensions.name: Broken supporting-file reference
project_package_extensions.trigger: An explicit relative path or Markdown link in SKILL.md/reference points to a file absent from the complete skill package.
project_package_extensions.exclusion: Ignore URLs, templated paths, documented generated files, or deliberately external paths.
project_package_extensions.verification: Resolve relative to skill root with symlink containment checks; record broken path.

project_package_extensions.name: Undocumented runtime dependency
project_package_extensions.trigger: Referenced executable script requires a nonstandard executable/library/service absent from documented prerequisites/compatibility.
project_package_extensions.exclusion: A dependency bundled in repo or standard with declared platform is satisfied.
project_package_extensions.verification: Parse imports and subprocess targets; compare requirements/config and docs.

project_package_extensions.name: Instruction–implementation contradiction
project_package_extensions.trigger: Active SKILL.md instructions and actual script interface/behavior disagree (flags, file locations, returned fields, effect).
project_package_extensions.exclusion: Multiple compatible usage modes are not contradictions.
project_package_extensions.verification: Trace one claim to implementation/test and record both line ranges.
project_package_extensions.repair: Update instruction or script and add regression test.

project_package_extensions.name: Unprotected side effect in supporting script
project_package_extensions.trigger: Referenced script modifies persistent jobs, files, system state, or network targets beyond advertised behavior without adequate guardrails.
project_package_extensions.exclusion: Normal user-requested side effects with safe target and scope are not defects.
project_package_extensions.verification: Static data-flow and guard review; test in hermetic fixture if appropriate.

project_package_extensions.name: Reproducible functional correctness failure
project_package_extensions.trigger: A normal documented use case produces wrong output, wrong timing, a crash, or incompatible artifact, verified with safe deterministic test.
project_package_extensions.exclusion: Speculative possible errors without a demonstrable supported input do not count.
project_package_extensions.verification: Create minimal expected-vs-actual fixture in sandbox, no untrusted execution on host.
project_package_extensions.repair: Patch logic and prove regression passes.

spec_preflight.name: Missing SKILL.md
spec_preflight.trigger: skill folder does not contain SKILL.md exactly where required
spec_preflight.origin: Official Agent Skills specification, operationalized by SkillGuard

spec_preflight.name: Invalid YAML frontmatter
spec_preflight.trigger: frontmatter missing delimiters or is not parseable as expected YAML mapping
spec_preflight.origin: Official Agent Skills specification, operationalized by SkillGuard

spec_preflight.name: Invalid skill name
spec_preflight.trigger: name absent, malformed, >64, consecutive hyphens, or does not equal parent directory
spec_preflight.origin: Official Agent Skills specification, operationalized by SkillGuard

spec_preflight.name: Invalid description length
spec_preflight.origin: Official Agent Skills specification, operationalized by SkillGuard

smell_crosswalk.mapping_note: Partial overlap; workflow quality

smell_crosswalk.name: The Option Buffet
smell_crosswalk.mapping_note: Partial overlap; unclear default selection

smell_crosswalk.name: Missing Utility Script
smell_crosswalk.mapping_note: No direct counterpart; track as separate skill-smell if relevant

smell_crosswalk.name: Missing Decision Tree
smell_crosswalk.mapping_note: No strict equivalent

smell_crosswalk.name: Series of Commands
smell_crosswalk.mapping_note: Potentially conflicts with a deliberately deterministic workflow

smell_crosswalk.name: No Validation Step
smell_crosswalk.mapping_note: No direct counterpart; missing validation is not itself a reproduced P5 failure

smell_crosswalk.name: Execute Without a Plan
smell_crosswalk.mapping_note: Only overlapping for high-impact actions

smell_crosswalk.name: Never Asks Human
smell_crosswalk.mapping_note: Only overlapping when user approval is warranted

smell_crosswalk.name: Rationalization Loophole
smell_crosswalk.mapping_note: Weak conceptual link only; no exact equivalent

smell_crosswalk.name: No Progress Tracking
smell_crosswalk.mapping_note: No exact equivalent; multi-step work only

smell_crosswalk.name: Undelegated Detail
smell_crosswalk.mapping_note: Close overlap

smell_crosswalk.name: Lengthy Skill Body
smell_crosswalk.mapping_note: Different thresholds: 5000 words vs 500 lines

smell_crosswalk.name: Lengthy Skill Name
smell_crosswalk.mapping_note: Same official 64-character maximum

smell_crosswalk.name: Lengthy Skill Description
smell_crosswalk.mapping_note: 1024 official chars vs 300 heuristic

smell_crosswalk.name: Confusing Skill Description
smell_crosswalk.mapping_note: Close semantic overlap

smell_crosswalk.name: No Guardrails
smell_crosswalk.mapping_note: Only when guarded action is relevant

smell_crosswalk.name: Buried Gotchas
smell_crosswalk.mapping_note: No exact equivalent; information placement

smell_crosswalk.name: Missing Usage Rules
smell_crosswalk.mapping_note: Partial overlap with trigger guidance

smell_crosswalk.name: Missing Caveats
smell_crosswalk.mapping_note: No exact equivalent

smell_crosswalk.name: Missing Example
smell_crosswalk.mapping_note: No exact equivalent; examples not mandatory

smell_crosswalk.name: Time Sensitive Skill
smell_crosswalk.mapping_note: Only when stale time assumption causes demonstrable failure

smell_crosswalk.name: XML Included Description
smell_crosswalk.mapping_note: Potential injection marker; no proof of actual exploit

smell_crosswalk.name: Backslash Path
smell_crosswalk.mapping_note: Not equivalent; Windows paths can be valid

smell_crosswalk.name: Unclear Skill Name
smell_crosswalk.mapping_note: Name quality vs description quality; only indirect overlap

smell_crosswalk.name: Non Third Person Description
smell_crosswalk.mapping_note: Stylistic; not a direct routing failure

smell_crosswalk.name: Missing Template
smell_crosswalk.mapping_note: Only when output format promised but implementation lacks it

review_protocol.unit: finding instance identified by (skill content hash, rule ID, normalized affected file, evidence span); track higher-level behavior_id separately
review_protocol.deduplication: Do not double count same rule+file+span across scanner configs; separately group correlated findings into one behavior_id; multiple R codes may apply per behavior.
review_protocol.safe_validation: Never run untrusted scripts on host; only static review or isolated disposable sandbox with denied network and restricted permissions.
review_protocol.assessment_workflow: One researcher records preliminary candidate_status, impact, recommended_fix, and investigation_notes. Do not treat scanner counts as confirmed defects or claim inter-rater agreement.
